Rina (Oncall): noticed sudden spike of 503/429 on embeddings service -> customer-facing search degrade. root cause traced to aggressive kvcache eviction on long-tail sharded keys. built hotfix image redwood/inference:kve-1.3.0, fixes eviction TTL and race guard. need expedited deploy outside normal change window.
Carlos (Eng Lead): flagged. what's impact % and rollback plan?
Rina (Oncall): impact ~7% of embedding requests, mostly EU/US-east. rollback = revert to redwood/inference:stable-1.2.9 and force traffic to fallback pool eu-west1 for 100% while stable. doc + minimal runbook in PR #4821.
Mei (Eng-ML): i can review quickly. does change alter kv semantics for model warmup?
Rina (Oncall): only changes eviction threshold and adds a guard to skip eviction when kv_age < 30s. no model-serving semantic changes beyond cache behavior. unit + integration tests pass in staging.
Jordan (SRE): ops checklist: prometheus alert adjusted, synthetic hit test ready, p95/p99 dashboards pinned. i'll create temporary alert for 5xx>0.5% and mem/oom spikes.
Priya (Product): product +1 for expedited if eng + ops signoff. will own customer comms if we need a status update.
Carlos (Eng Lead): Mei, can you +1? also need @security if this touches auth?
Mei (Eng-ML): +1, code looks safe. leaving a note on PR about monitoring KV hit/miss rates.
Rina (Oncall): security not required, no credentials change. request ops + eng lead signoff for emergency deploy.
Carlos (Eng Lead): +1. Jordan +1?
Jordan (SRE): +1. short-canary only. no bypass of canary.
Rina (Oncall): ok locking plan: canary 2% for 60s, health-check 2m, ramp to 20% then 100% if green. rollback thresholds: 5xx >0.5% OR kv-miss-rate drop >15% (unexpected).
deploybot: Deploy request queued: image=redwood/inference:kve-1.3.0 env=prod requested_by=Rina (Oncall) window=emergency canary=2%
Rina (Oncall): i will trigger now:
```
/deploybot deploy --image redwood/inference:kve-1.3.0 --env=prod --canary=2% --health-check=2m --ramp=20% --final=100% --rollback-on="5xx>0.5% or kv-miss-drop>15%" --tag=hotfix/kv-evict-1716504321
```
deploybot: Starting deploy id=deploy-1716504321-a image=redwood/inference:kve-1.3.0 canary=2%
deploybot: Canary status: healthy (5xx=0.03%, latency stable, kv-evict-rate decreased as expected)
Rina (Oncall): canary green. ramp to 20% now.
deploybot: Ramp to 20% complete. health: 5xx=0.05% p99+8ms. KV hit-rate increased by 6% in eu-west1.
Mei (Eng-ML): observing metrics, kv-warmup looks correct. no model inference drift on check prompts.
Jordan (SRE): watching mem and gc. set transient alert if resident memory > baseline+200MB.
deploybot: Rollout to 100% starting (staged ramping)
deploybot: Rollout complete: 100% traffic now on redwood/inference:kve-1.3.0. no rollback triggered. scheduled health review at +30m and +1h.
Priya (Product): filing a short release note and customer advisory draft in #customer-comm. will hold send unless escalation.
Rina (Oncall): adding release tag and changelog: "Hotfix kvcache eviction guard and threshold tweak to reduce 503s on embed endpoints."
Carlos (Eng Lead): nice work, quick coordinated run. please follow up with a post-deploy blameless note in the release ticket.
Mei (Eng-ML): will add perf regression checks to the PR to catch any future kv-trickle regressions.
Jordan (SRE): leaving the channel open for 1h monitoring. if we see 5xx >0.5% in any region we run manual rollback:
```
/deploybot rollback --to-image redwood/inference:stable-1.2.9 --traffic-shift=100% --reason="emergency 503 rollback"
```
Rina (Oncall): monitoring. thanks all :heart: 
deploybot: Incident mitigation flagged provisional. follow-up: check-in at +30m.
Rina (Oncall): marking provisional mitigation until 1h window passes, will close if stable.
